description: Register a non-canonical artifact (snapshot, journal entry, finding, etc.) on a feature. Canonical artifacts (design.md, plan.md, …) inside the feature folder are auto-discovered and rejected here. Stores in feature.json artifacts[]; dedups on (type, path); appends an audit event (best-effort).

force.description: Overwrite an existing entry with the same (type, path)

line.description: Required for artifact_type "incident": the 1-based ledger line, which must start with "- " (else INCIDENT_LINE_INVALID). The path, line and first 200 characters are stored.

path.description: Repo-relative path. Must exist; cannot contain ".." after normalization.

name: link_artifact
